========================================================================
  Jampot  —  Free Packs
  Four complete environment kits + 5 treasure chests. 89 models.
========================================================================

These are the Jampot kits that are free on their own itch.io pages, put
together in one download so you can try the whole style before buying
the rest.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
WHAT'S INSIDE
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  01 Rustic Pack            21 models
  02 Tavern Pack            21 models
  03 Keep Pack              21 models
  08 Dvergr Pack            21 models
  Chests (5 free)           5 textured chests with separate lids

Each style kit is a complete building kit: a door, a window, walls
(straight / corner / floor), fences (straight / corner / gate), terrain
(flat / slope / cliff / corner), a piece of furniture, a bench, a light
pole, and barrels and crates in closed, open and stacked versions.

All four kits came off the same source geometry, so their pieces line up
with each other. A Keep wall meets a Rustic wall at the same height and
the same snap points, and the same is true of the six paid kits.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
WANT THE REST?
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The full set is 265 models: ten style kits plus 60 chests, in one
  download. https://jampot-gg.itch.io/complete-bundle

------------------------------------------------------------------------
TECHNICAL
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Poly count          Low. Whole kits sit in the tens of thousands of tris.
  Pivots / transform  Base on the floor, centred in XY, identity rotation.
                      Real-world scale (a door is ~2.4 m). True drop-in.
  Materials           One flat-colour Principled/PBR material per surface
                      on the style kits, no texture files to wrangle. The
                      chests are the exception and ship their own textures.
  Formats             FBX and GLB per piece, plus each kit as one .blend.
